recipes.title: Whole shrimp garlic butter
recipes.description: 蒜香奶油明蝦 - garlic butter prawns (from yuyuan_hsu).
ingredients: 明蝦 / Large prawns 1 catty (~8-10 pcs)
帕馬森起司 / Parmesan cheese, a little
歐芹碎 / Chopped parsley, a little
steps: Prep the prawns: trim the whiskers, press the head to remove the vein, and cut the belly down to the bottom so they peel easily when eating. Pat dry.
Heat a pan with olive oil and butter, add the minced garlic and stir on low heat until fragrant.
Arrange the prawns neatly, sear briefly, then pour in the white wine, cover, and simmer 2 min.
Open the lid, flip the prawns, and add the heavy cream. Season with salt and black pepper.
Reduce the sauce slightly, then plate and garnish with shaved parmesan and chopped parsley.
